# IBKR WebAPI | Trading Web API

The [/reauthenticate endpoint](/docs/campus/ibkr-api-page/cpapi-v1#reauthenticate), used to reconnect a disconnected session, has been flagged as DEPRECATED, and all use of the endpoint should instead be handled with /iserver/auth/ssodh/init endpoint.
